checked: Read the complete TeX and note. Checked IsWu, exact real and quotient measures, phInf, WuWeighted and WuReprod, original discrete-series and lowest-type hypotheses, signed parameter and moving rank in the authenticated source.

Checked that every actual opposite-sign parameter gap, including compact-head to negative-tail comparisons, is at least 16*n^19. The original smooth-decay theorem applies without a uniform seminorm constant. Exact Cartan root sum is 2pq; the original N1 exponent is covered at every place and under the product measure.

Checked Schur orthogonality with conjugate-linear-first inner products and the literal p=d*conjugate(m). Its convolution idempotence and corner identity hold with the original formal degrees and right translation order.

Checked the induced-space construction of T_F from finite Gram identities. Smooth induced vectors admit continuous evaluation by local Sobolev estimates, and evaluation embeds intertwiners in the original Bessel functional space.

Read primary Jiang-Sun-Zhu Theorem A and its continuous smooth completed-tensor-product formulation. The original subgroup of U(k+r,r+1) has compact Levi U(k), the generic flag character is unchanged and the compact target is irreducible. The product-of-places multiplicity bound is justified separately.

Checked use of the already supplied unit-L2 seed to identify the rank-one range; no existence or nonvanishing is inferred from another map. A compact truncation has positive A_E, and weighted Tonelli with nu(yt^-1)<=nu(y)M(t) gives exactly the original weighted integral. No uniform bound on A_E^-1 is claimed.

Read primary Yamashita Proposition2.1(a) and checked the compact central extension. A K-conjugation-averaged approximate identity acts by a nonzero scalar on the multiplicity-one lowest type; its normalization gives an exact compact reproducer for the original seed. Full support of quotient Haar upgrades Hilbert equality to pointwise equality.

Independently reran the checker: eight authenticated modules, four primary PDF hashes, 2028 signed-gap pairs, symbolic all-rank budgets, six nonabelian convolution corner identities, two induced rank-one models and 91 exact weighted Tonelli checks. These are supplementary diagnostics, not a Lean kernel verification.
